doc.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001

title: Working with George Gee's band
summary: George Gee's band in Zurich the same night as Basie.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah, right. Yeah it doesn’t happen too often anymore. I’m working with a band now, George Gee, and it’s been together for about fifteen years. I mean it’s spasmodic, you know, working here and there. But we went to Zurich and worked this past summer. And it was great.
George Gee. Yeah he plays for swing dancing a lot. But it’s a good band. In fact the first night in Zurich we played in the train station and the other band was Basie. So Basie’s band and George Gee.
Wow. Like the old Savoy days, huh?
